q: The verifier asks to see our calculation workings. What should we hand over?
title: Calculation workings for the verifier
short: A file or report showing, for each source, the activity data, unit, factor, any conversion and the result, with a reference to the bill or invoice behind each figure. Totals should add up, and any estimate should be marked with its method.
audience: MSMEs and suppliers going through GHG verification

ul: Conversions such as litres to kilograms.
Result in kg or tonnes CO2e.

p: Each line should point to its source document, so the verifier can sample and recalculate.
Missing data filled by estimate needs a short note on the method and the share of the total it covers.

senseible: Senseible keeps each record with its source document, fingerprint, factor and method version, so a verifier can trace any figure back to the bill it came from.

sources.label: ISO 14064-3, validation and verification of GHG statements
